sections.summary:
The Sunday Studio is a thoughtfully curated home and lifestyle brand for people who believe that everyday spaces can feel extraordinary. We bring together small-batch homewares, considered design, and a slower approach to living.

Our first chapter is an online collection of essentials, supported by intimate pop-up experiences. We aim to become the go-to destination for accessible, independent design.
sections.problem: Design-conscious customers often choose between mass-market products with little character and independent pieces priced out of reach. We bridge the gap with a carefully edited collection, transparent sourcing, and approachable pricing.
sections.market: Our primary audience is urban professionals aged 25–40 who value design, sustainability, and a personal connection to the things they buy. We will begin with a focused local audience and validate demand through a small launch collection.
sections.business: Direct-to-consumer sales through our online store, complemented by seasonal pop-ups. Our target variable cost is 25% of revenue. A focused product range and small initial production runs help us learn before scaling.
sections.marketing: Start with a founder-led community on Instagram and Pinterest, a weekly editorial newsletter, and collaborations with local interior designers. Launch with a limited collection and collect customer feedback before expanding.
